title: Payment and Credit in International Trade

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply knowledge about foreign exchange rates in international trade.
Understand and apply knowledge about various payment instruments used in international trade.
Understand and apply knowledge about different payment methods in international trade.
Understand and apply knowledge about various credit instruments used in international trade.
Understand and apply knowledge about negotiable instruments such as bills of exchange and promissory notes.
Understand and apply knowledge about conditions specified in international trade contracts.
Understand and apply knowledge about banking procedures involved in international trade.
Develop independent work skills including research, analysis, and problem-solving in international trade contexts.
Develop collaborative work skills including teamwork, communication, and presentation in international trade contexts.
Develop self-learning abilities including time management, critical thinking, and continuous improvement in international trade contexts.
Demonstrate ethical conduct and responsibility in applying knowledge about international trade.
Demonstrate compliance with legal regulations and standards in international trade activities.
